label: Вместе
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вместе (together) showing joint action across tenses and contexts.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Joint action. 'Вместе' means 'together' and modifies 'идём', showing the movement is done jointly. It commonly sits before the verb with a plural subject.
Strategic focus: Proposal of teamwork. 'Вместе' modifies the infinitive 'работать' inside a 'давай' proposal. It frames the work as a shared effort.
Strategic focus: Shared past. 'Вместе' modifies the past verb 'учились', meaning the studying happened jointly. It is the standard way to say people were classmates.
Strategic focus: Cohabitation. 'Вместе' modifies 'живут', meaning they live as a unit. 'Уже год' adds duration to the shared living.
Strategic focus: Gathering into one. 'Вместе' modifies 'соберём', meaning everything is brought into a single whole. Here it conveys assembly rather than companionship.
Strategic focus: Joint resolution. 'Вместе' modifies the future verb 'решим', stressing a shared effort to solve something. It reassures by signalling cooperation.
Strategic focus: Shared activity. 'Вместе' modifies 'играют', showing the children play as a group. The adverb after the verb is a natural placement.
Strategic focus: Joint trip. 'Вместе' modifies the future motion verb 'поедем', framing the journey as shared. It often closes the clause for warm emphasis.
Strategic focus: Habitual togetherness. 'Вместе' modifies 'делаем', meaning the couple or pair do everything jointly. It expresses a close, ongoing partnership.
Strategic focus: Shared plan. 'Вместе' modifies 'пообедаем', framing the lunch as joint. It rounds off an invitation built on two coordinated verbs.
